name: us-tax-mcp
description: Zero-dependency MCP server that computes US federal, state and LOCAL tax — federal income tax, self-employment tax, FICA, capital gains, NIIT, the child tax credit and EITC, Section 199A, the SALT cap, quarterly estimated payments and Publication 15-T paycheck withholding for 2024-2026, plus state income tax for 24 states including New Jersey, whose filing threshold makes the next dollar cost $126 and whose retirement exclusion costs a joint retiree $1,381 on one dollar at $150,000 of income, and New York, whose supplemental tax recaptures the lower brackets so a high earner pays their top rate on their whole income, New York City and Yonkers — a New York City resident owes more city tax than the entire state tax of twelve of those states — and the Empire State child credit, whose phase-out cuts the whole credit rather than each child's share, so a family with three young children keeps some of it to $291,000. Compares a household across tax years, reports the true marginal rate including credit phase-outs and state and city cliffs, tells an employee what to put on Form W-4 Step 4(c), and cites the IRS release or state statute behind every figure.

scripts.build: npm run sync && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/finalize.mjs
